'''Dractuvians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], red-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dractu]]. They built paved streets and resided in homes made of stone.<ref name="Appetite for Adventure" />

The [[Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster]] traveled to Dractu in search of a [[Dractuvian cave slug]], intending to prepare the dish for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at [[Dex's Diner]]. In a Dractuvian village, Dexter spoke with a local elder bearing a long orange beard. A Dractuvian [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|warrior]] volunteered to assist him and was trusted by the other to do so. The warrior guided Dexter to a cave where the slug could be found. Dexter was attacked by the creature but was ultimately rescued by the warrior.<ref name="Appetite for Adventure" />
